name: Çukurova Arabic (Cilician)

ancestors.notes: Inherited placeholder table; see notes on ar-TR-x-cukurova.

notes: The Arabic dialects of the Çukurova plain in southern Turkey. ATTESTED, NOT YET DESCRIBED HERE. A published description exists and is named in `sources`; its phonology has not been read into this spec. The grapheme table is inherited from the parent and is a placeholder, NOT a claim about this variety — no reflex below has been checked against the source. The entry exists so the lect has a code and resolves to something usable rather than to nothing; `quality` is `stub` for exactly that reason. Replace the inherited table with cited reflexes before treating any reading here as this variety's. The parent is Syrian on geographic and historical grounds — these are Levantine-derived dialects north of the Syrian border — and that placement is itself unverified against Prochazka.

sources.author: Watson, J.C.E. & Asiri, B.
sources.title: Pre-pausal devoicing and glottalisation in varieties of the south-western Arabian Peninsula
